title: Demo area
intro: All the pages below only use local demo data (Dexie). No server calls, so you can safely walk through the flow.
warning: Demo mode — the data shown here is fake and stored locally. Nothing you do on these screens will affect your real account.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.text: Follow the steps below to simulate the full gluten-free tax credit process using demo data.

cards_comparatif_text: Edit a few gluten-free products (price, formats, units) to show how the comparison table is built.
cards_rapports_text: Trigger a (fake) report generation, then show the printable version with calculated totals.
cards_liste_text: Create/complete a grocery list using demo products (free + invoice items) with total cost estimation.
cards_factures_text: Create and edit a few demo invoices to demonstrate how invoice and item entry works.
footer_tip: Tip: because everything is local, you can break or change these demo records without any impact on your real data.

step1.title: Open your invoices
step1.body: Start by opening the invoice list. From there, you’ll be able to use an existing invoice.
step1.hint: Click this button to see your demo invoices.

step7.title: Compare your gluten-free costs
step7.body: Now that your invoice is ready, open the comparison page to see how your gluten-free products compare to the reference products.
step7.hint: Click this button to open the comparison for your current year.
